native_findings.finding: The retained WCCMMUD.DLL exports its module auto-cleanup entry point as _ljngame_mcurou. The body owns the gang-house tax/deed/eviction/room-cleanup work and finishes with the final gang-record sweep/cleanup-complete path.
MajorBBS/Worldgroup invokes each module's mcurou once per day. The documented historical default is 03:00 local host time; the host owns/configures the cleanup wall-clock time.
Gang-house taxation is not gated on a separately recovered in-game daylight/sunset scheduler. The executable owner is the host daily auto-cleanup callback.

No retained MajorMUD evidence proves replay/catch-up of a missed mcurou event after process restart. Reforged therefore schedules the next future host cleanup occurrence and does not manufacture a missed callback.

runtime_corrections: Gang-house upkeep is now named and routed as daily auto-cleanup rather than an inferred in-game sundown callback.
Classic host bootstrap registers a one-minute probe around an exact once-daily scheduled callback; the probe itself never causes extra cleanup executions.
The historical 03:00 local host default is used unless a future host-configuration owner supplies another cleanup time.
A restart after today's cleanup time schedules tomorrow's callback; no missed-event catch-up is invented.
The daily callback runs gang-house bank taxation/repossession and the disbanded-gang zero-member sweep.
